asserts: both sides seal halves of one deal, each citing the other half and the other side's checkpoint; each pushes its half at completion with share_record_at_completion on; the receiver holds the foreign bytes by digest and seals a record citing them; acceptance is keyed on the evidence key under a controller declaration
detail: node stevenmih-1: 2 held halves, each held by its digest (Class 1 and the capsule_id recomputed by the AAC Go verifier), under the checkpoint it was pushed with (evidencebook), and cited as counterparty_half by the node's own record; node stevenmih-2: 1 held halves, each held by its digest (Class 1 and the capsule_id recomputed by the AAC Go verifier), under the checkpoint it was pushed with (evidencebook), and cited as counterparty_half by the node's own record; node stevenmih-3: 1 held halves, each held by its digest (Class 1 and the capsule_id recomputed by the AAC Go verifier), under the checkpoint it was pushed with (evidencebook), and cited as counterparty_half by the node's own record; exchanges with a half held on each of two nodes: 1. Spend: none; this step starts no exchange and pays nothing (would spend 0 USD).
name: deal

not_checked.what: halves that cite each other and the other side's checkpoint
not_checked.why: a half the pinned capsules plugin seals cites neither the other half nor the other side's checkpoint; only the receiver's citing record cites the half it holds

not_checked.what: each side pushing its half at completion by default
not_checked.why: share_record_at_completion is off by default in the pinned plugin, and a node's setting is not in its data dir to read

not_checked.what: acceptance of a pushed half keyed on the sender's evidence key under a controller declaration
not_checked.why: the pinned capsules plugin accepts a push on the host-announced peer id (or CAPSULES_PEER_KEYS), not on an evidence key under a controller declaration

not_checked.what: the held half's producer signature, in a second language
not_checked.why: Class 1 does not include it and the pinned Go verifier has no envelope mode
